import html # Example HTML template with placeholders for the title and body. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {heading}

{heading}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully formatted, HTML‑escaped blog post ready for rendering. Raises ------ ValueError If either heading or text is empty after stripping whitespace. """ # Basic validation: non-empty strings if not heading or not heading.strip(): raise ValueError("Heading cannot be empty.") if not text or not text.strip(): raise ValueError("Text cannot be empty.") # Escape user input to prevent XSS attacks safe_heading = html.escape(heading.strip(), quote=True) # Convert newlines to
for paragraph breaks safe_body = html.escape(text.strip(), quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Populate the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(heading=safe_heading, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
